ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central zones on both lobes. Thick, irregular black banding along the entire trailing edge. Focal circular dark spot on the mid-left lobe. Focal crescent-shaped dark mark on the outer-right lobe. Extensive dark mottling transitioning from the trailing edge towards the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression; central vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence at the baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full length of the trailing edge; pixel amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips, corresponding to barnacle-induced edge deformation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips, characterized by a steady increase in vertical pixel elevation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right distal tips, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, passing through the white pigment field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular dark pigment mark/scar on the left lobe; distinct crescent-shaped dark mark on the right lobe; significant physical tissue extension at tips due to barnacle clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of a circular eye-like spot on the left and a smile-like crescent on the right lobe against a mostly white field.
